title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Internal Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a team building internal mobile apps: roles, data connections, field capture, private distribution, and a price that does not grow with every seat.
body_markdown: Field teams typically need job details, photos, and signatures with no signal. Offline behavior is not documented for most tools here, and Base44's wrapper has no full offline mode, so test on a real phone before committing.
